CoFID_2021_category_crosswalk.citation: Public Health England, McCance and Widdowson's Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset, 2021, workbook values and food groups.
CoFID_2021_category_crosswalk.note: Numeric zeros are distinguished from Tr, N, and blank source markers.

BARFLAB_CIQUAL_2025.citation: BARFLAB veal brain profile, citing CIQUAL 2025 food 40006 and USDA SR Legacy FDC 174351. Used only as a raw-to-cooked fatty-acid analogue, scaled to target total fat.

mappings.sourceName: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw
mappings.conversion: CoFID reports explicit numeric zero for raw spring onions. Target is cooked in water without added fat; the zero remains zero on the same gram basis.
Raw veal-brain omega-6 value scaled by target total fat 6.706 g divided by source total fat 8.21 g. This is a raw-to-cooked analogue estimate.

mappings.sourceName: Beef, variety meats and by-products, brain, raw
mappings.conversion: Raw beef-brain trans-fat value scaled by target total fat 6.706 g divided by source total fat 10.3 g. This is a species and cooking analogue estimate, not a direct measurement.
